summary: Drive and anger flow with power and transformation. This fluid pattern asks you to use courage and depth with awareness.
body: Drive and anger flow with power and transformation. This fluid pattern asks you to use courage and depth with awareness. Strength and stamina without the strain. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through drive and anger, power and transformation, and the choices you make when reactivity or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is courage, depth, and a more conscious way to work with drive and anger and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is reactivity, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let drive and anger and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
do: Name how drive and anger and power and transformation are both involved
Turn courage and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Ignore the needs of drive and anger or power and transformation
